meta.name: model-merging
meta.description: Merge multiple fine-tuned models using mergekit to combine capabilities without retraining. Use when creating specialized models by blending domain-specific expertise (math + coding + chat), improving performance beyond single models, or experimenting rapidly with model variants. Covers SLERP, TIES-Merging, DARE, Task Arithmetic, linear merging, and production deployment strategies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 合并多个微调模型，无需重新训练即可组合能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有多个微调模型想合并成一个更强的模型
copy.tagline_en: Merge multiple fine-tuned models to combine capabilities without retraining
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have multiple fine-tuned models and want to merge them into a stronger one

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你合并多个微调模型，无需重新训练。你需要提供 YAML 配置文件，Claude 会调用 mergekit 工具生成合并后的模型。
howto.when: 当你想把多个模型的能力（如数学、代码、对话）融合成一个，或提升单模型性能，或快速实验不同模型组合时触发。

say.text: 写一个SLERP合并的YAML配置，合并两个模型。
say.note: 返回配置内容，可进一步执行。

say.text: 用TIES合并三个模型，基座用Mistral-7B。
say.note: 会根据说明生成相应的ties配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can merge multiple fine-tuned models without retraining. You provide a YAML config, and Claude uses mergekit to produce a merged model.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to combine capabilities from multiple models (e.g., math, coding, chat), improve performance beyond a single model, or rapidly experiment with model variants.

say_en.text: Merge Mistral-7B and OpenHermes-2.5 with linear method at 0.5:0.5 weights.
Write a SLERP merge YAML config for two models.
say_en.note: Returns config content for further execution.

say_en.text: Use TIES to merge three models with Mistral-7B as base.
